description: Characters at the ends that are not ASCII whitespace: NBSP, zero-width space, an ideographic space on its own, a BOM, and a decomposed e + U+0301. Trimming removes Unicode White_Space plus U+FEFF, so NBSP, U+3000 and the BOM go (an ideographic-space-only answer is unanswered) but U+200B stays; text is not NFC-normalised (semantics §2).
